```python
from sklearn.datasets import load_iris
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.linear_model import SGDClassifier
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss

X, y = load_iris(return_X_y=True)

    X, y, test_size=0.25, random_state=42, stratify=y
)

# Model (SGD = learns step-by-step, so we can track loss)
clf = SGDClassifier(loss="log_loss", max_iter=1, learning_rate="constant", eta0=0.01, tol=None)
classes = sorted(set(y))

# Training loop (epochs): each partial_fit step updates model params
epochs = 50
train_losses, test_losses = [], []

for _ in range(epochs):
    clf.partial_fit(X_train, y_train, classes=classes)

    # Predict probabilities so we can compute log_loss
    p_train = clf.predict_proba(X_train)
    p_test  = clf.predict_proba(X_test)

    train_losses.append(log_loss(y_train, p_train))
    test_losses.append(log_loss(y_test, p_test))

print("Final train loss:", train_losses[-1])
print("Final test loss: ", test_losses[-1])
```
